name: r04-ext-v1
note: Extra actor ramps for the R04 (Abraham) enemies, light to dark, added on top of the unchanged art 03 master palette (byte copy in src/palette_v03.json). Ramp names must not collide with the base. Reused base ramps: bone (D1 mane, dust, D3 mask), stone (D2 cage), lining (D3 raid blanket), leather (saddlebags), gold (plunder glint), ribbon (D3 eye), eye (D1 eye), white, outline.

why.rust: D1 body: a warm rust-brown, darker than the light path and redder than the grass, so a D1 pack reads on both grounds
why.lure: D2 false light: pink-violet, away from the cyan XP gems, the gold pickups and the green grass; the brightest D2 pixels are the lie that draws the eye
why.steed: D3 coat: a dark bay-charcoal, the darkest R04 body so the bone mask and red blanket of the charger stand out
